up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the ChEMBL database where the standard type is 'IC50' and the pChEMBL value is not null. The target must be the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1824', name 'Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2' (target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', tax_id = 9606). For each such activity, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax ID (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the result to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type AS standard_type, activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
